headline: Pays East Bay Asian Youth Center up to $30,765 for lunch and recess supervision at Lincoln Elementary
summary: East Bay Asian Youth Center will provide up to two staff to supervise the schoolyard at lunch at Lincoln Elementary School. They will lead recess activities, help students resolve playground conflicts and encourage good sportsmanship. The agreement runs from August 28, 2023 to May 23, 2024 and began before this vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Street Academy Foundation - Street Academy
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Street Academy Foundation, Oakland, CA, for the latter to operate the Emiliano Zapata Street Academy (aka Street Academy), as a credit recovery/dropout prevention alternative high school, providing a fully accredited college preparatory and career readiness program implementing the independent study model of attendance using work samples as well as daily attendance which allows the best support for enrolled students to meet their needs and to keep them in school, assisting at-risk students (approximately 115 students in grades 9-12); and having the Counselor Teacher Mentor (CTM) model provide a holistic educational experience with teachers also serving as counselors and mentors utilizing a restorative justice model of interaction, for the period of August 7, 2023 through May 23, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $736,835.00.
headline: Pays Street Academy Foundation up to $736,835 to run Street Academy, an alternative high school
summary: Street Academy Foundation will operate the Emiliano Zapata Street Academy, an alternative high school for credit recovery and dropout prevention. It serves about 115 at-risk students in grades 9-12 using an independent study model. The agreement runs from August 7, 2023 to May 23, 2024 and began before this vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - East Bay Agency for Children - Greenleaf Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and East Bay Agency for Children, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a Bilingual Spanish Mental Health provider to support individual students with direct counseling services to a caseload of between 10-15 children, meeting with students one on one on a weekly basis to support children’s development of mental health well-being, work on social skills, and address trauma.at Greenleaf Elementary School, for the period of August 7, 2023 through May 31, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $60,000.00.
funding_source: CCSPP Implementation Grant and Title 4-Student Support
headline: Pays East Bay Agency for Children up to $60,000 for a bilingual mental health provider at Greenleaf
summary: East Bay Agency for Children will provide a Spanish-speaking mental health provider at Greenleaf Elementary School. The provider will counsel 10-15 children one on one each week on well-being, social skills and trauma. The agreement runs from August 7, 2023 to May 31, 2024 and began before this vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Blueprint Schools Network - Middle School Network
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Blueprint Schools Network, Needham, MA, for the latter to provide high dosage, small group math tutoring to middle school students as part of the regular school day, including supporting a full-time Math Fellow-at-large who can provide coverage for other tutors who are absent or join a campus to provide additional instructional assistance, via Middle School Network, for the period of September 27, 2023 through June 30, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $70,000.00.
headline: Pays Blueprint Schools Network up to $70,000 for small-group math tutoring for middle school students
summary: Blueprint Schools Network will provide small-group math tutoring during the regular school day for middle school students. This includes supporting a full-time Math Fellow who can cover for absent tutors or add help at a campus. The agreement runs from September 27, 2023 to June 30, 2024 and began before this vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Northeastern University - Mills College Campus, Lead by Learning - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Northeastern University-Mills College Campus, Lead by Learning, Boston, MA, for the latter to develop teacher instructional capacity by engaging in equity-driven collaborative inquiry focused on students’ daily learning experiences and outcomes in alignment with districtwide instructional priorities dependent on specific content areas, departments, or focal student populations; engage the Elementary Social Emotional Learning (SEL) Lead Learners in a Districtwide Teacher Inquiry Partnership, via Academics and Instruction Department, for the period of August 1, 2023 through June 28, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $39,420.00.
headline: Pays Northeastern University's Mills campus up to $39,420 for teacher inquiry work on social emotional learning
summary: Northeastern University-Mills College Campus (Lead by Learning) will work with elementary social emotional learning lead teachers on a districtwide teacher inquiry partnership. The goal is to build teachers' skills by looking closely at students' daily learning. The service period began August 1, 2023, before the Board's October vote to ratify it, and runs through June 28, 2024.
vendor_name: Northeastern University-Mills College Campus, Lead by Learning
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Children Rising - Sankofa United Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Children Rising, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide its Path2Mth early numeracy program, using California Common Core curriculum, to provide foundational math instruction and support for Sankofa students performing substantially below grade level at Sankofa United Elementary School, for the period of September 25, 2023 through May 15, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00.

title: Memorandum of Understanding – The U.S. Geological Survey - Secondary Transition to Employment Program – USGS Partnership (STEP-UP) Program – Special Education Department
